sql_query.description: SQL query that should be executed on the provided database.

db_uri.description: Connection URI of the PostgreSQL database, e.g. postgresql://user:password@host:5432/database. Use a role that may only read the data the agent needs. Read-only mode stops writes in this connection, but only the role's privileges stop what reaches outside it, such as dblink, COPY ... TO PROGRAM and server file access (pg_read_file). So the role must not be a superuser or a member of pg_execute_server_program, pg_read_server_files or pg_write_server_files. Set this in the tool configuration, not by the agent — the agent never sees or sets this value.

read_only.description: When true (the default), only SELECT queries are allowed. Set this in the tool configuration, not by the agent — the agent never sees or sets this value.
